title: Three people talk about the Internet at work

script.text: I use the Internet at work every day. I answer emails and I look for information.
Me too. I think the Internet is great. It saves a lot of time.
I don't use it much at work. I think people shouldn't use the Internet for personal things when they are at the office.
Why not? Sometimes a short break is good. I read the news for ten minutes at lunchtime.
Maybe, but some people spend hours on social media. That is a waste of time, and it is bad for the company.
I agree it can be addictive. Some people can't stop using it. But it is very useful for work.
Also, some people prefer the Internet to sports or going out with friends.
That is true. But I don't think the Internet is dangerous if you are careful.

title: A call to technical support

script.text: Thank you for calling technical support. My name is Paul. How can I help you?
Hello. I can't log in to my computer. I think I forgot my password.
No problem. Could you tell me your full name and your employee number?
My name is Helen Ward. That is W, A, R, D. My employee number is four, seven, two, nine.
Thank you, Ms Ward. I am going to send a code to your mobile phone. Please type it on the screen.
OK. I have the code. It is six, one, three, nine, zero, eight.
Perfect. Now choose a new password. It must have at least ten characters and one number.
Done. It works! Thank you very much.
You're welcome. Remember, you should never share your password. Is there anything else I can help you with?
No, that is all. Goodbye.

title: How to replace the RAM in a laptop

script.text: Today I am going to show you how to replace the RAM in a laptop. First, shut down the laptop and unplug the charger. Then turn it over and unscrew the back panel. You need a small screwdriver. Next, find the memory module. Pull out the clips on the sides, and the old module pops up. Pull it out gently. Now take the new module, align the notch with the slot, and push it down until it snaps into place. Then close the panel, screw it again, and power on the laptop. Finally, check that the system shows sixteen gigabytes of memory. The whole job takes about ten minutes.

Because I like solving problems, and I want to learn more about servers.
What are your strengths?
I learn quickly and I can work in a team. My weakness is that I am a little shy.
Do you have any work experience?
I did a three-month internship in a small company. I installed computers and changed network cables.
Great. When can you start?
I can start next Monday.
